case.title: Set up deposits for new clients
case.subject: Deposits
case.text:
Hi! We keep getting no-shows from first-time clients. Can I make people pay a deposit when they book online? We don't have Stripe yet.

Chloe - Lash Lab
case.why: How-to fully covered by the payments & deposits article (connect Stripe, then require a deposit).

output.reply:
Hi Chloe,

Yes, you can require a deposit when clients book online. You don't need an existing Stripe account, because you can create one during setup.

1. Go to Settings → Payments and click Connect Stripe. Log in or create a new account, then finish Stripe's verification. Payouts start once Stripe has verified your business.
2. Go to Settings → Payments → Deposits and turn on Require deposit. Choose a fixed amount or a percentage of the service price. You can also limit deposits to specific services.

Clients pay the deposit on the booking page when they book. Please note that deposits are listed as part of the Pro plan. You can also set a cancellation policy under Settings → Payments → Cancellation policy, which lets you charge a no-show fee manually.

Slotwise Support
